texts.orig: According  to  the  'Subject-Verb  Agreement  Rule',  a  singular subject always takes a singular verb and a plural subject always takes a plural verb. The subject of the sentence is 'The meeting minutes',  where  'minutes'  is  a  plural  noun.  Therefore,  the  verb must  also  be  plural.  The  singular  verb  'contains'  must  be replaced  with  the  plural  verb  'contain'.  Hence,  'contain  several inaccuracies' is the most appropriate answer.

texts.text: Sol.133.(c) (3) - was available

texts.label: text
texts.orig: 'Neither…nor  /  Either…or'  is  a  correlative conjunction pair used for two subjects, and the verb agrees with the subject closest to it.  This  is  known  as  the  rule  of  proximity.  In this sentence, the subject nearest to the verb is 'the team leads,' which is plural. So, the verb must be plural as well. Therefore, 'was available' should be  replaced  with  'were  available.'  Hence,  'were  available' is the most appropriate answer.
